# Keka | Product Overview

Keka is an integrated staff experience-oriented HR, remuneration, recruitment, performance and project hours platform. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
